messages:
sana_ml: Heads-up — bringing odyssey-lite v1 through quantized onboarding (q4/ptq) and seeing a locale-shaped quality delta on our multilingual evals, esp zh->en and ar->en. Small but consistent.
li_zhang: can you paste the failing examples? quick glance might tell if it's tokenization or model behavior.
sana_ml: putting a few samples below. note: these are from the standard devset after pruning duplicates.
```
src: 我今天去了公园, 看到一只孩子在放风筝。
ref: I went to the park today and saw a child flying a kite.
q4_out: I went to the park today and saw a kid fly a kite.
q8_out: I went to the park today and saw a child flying a kite.
```
```
src: ...أما بعض الأشخاص فقد تراجعوا عن قراراتهم.
ref: ...and some people backtracked on their decisions.
q4_out: ...and some people retreated from their decisions.
q8_out: ...and some people backed out of their decisions.
```
li_zhang: first sample looks like a slight register change (kid vs child) — borderline. second one seems meaning-preserving but uses a stronger verb. are BLEU/chrF numbers spiking?
dave_infra: CI run (master q8 vs q4) shows avg BLEU drop ~0.9 on zh->en, ~1.2 on ar->en; most other pairs within noise. latency/cost improvements as expected.
eva_qc: I ran localized token-level diffs. For zh cases there's a burst of merged han tokens at the boundaries when q4 model produced shorter detokenized output. Example tokenization heatmap attached in CI artifacts (ci-bot link below).
toni_localization: also noticed bracket pairs flipping in rtl contexts — e.g., English parentheses end up on wrong side in mixed Arabic-English snippets. Might be bidi handling in postdetok.
sana_ml: interesting. my hunch: quantization changed logits around BOS/SEP boundaries, causing different greedy punctuation/space decisions plus tokenizer rounding edge-cases. Could also be subtle token id remapping if we used a compressed embedding table.
li_zhang: did we change tokenizer or vocab? onboarding used same tokenizer.json (v2) — no remap. I suspect detokenizer heuristics + q4 shorter token sequences.
dave_infra: build info: quant pipeline used ptq->minmax static; kernel mapping: q4 kernels from runtime v0.9.7. q8 used v0.9.5 path due to fallback. we upgraded kernels for q4 recently.
eva_qc: I ran an N-gram perturb test: take refs, remove honorifics or small function words, see model preference. q4 prefers shorter phrases more often (higher brevity).
toni_localization: sample with brackets:
```
src: قال "(This is a test)" أمام الجمهور.
ref: He said "(This is a test)" in front of the audience.
q4_out: He said "(This is a test)" in front of the audience.
q8_out: He said ")This is a test(" in front of the audience.
```
toni_localization: q8 did the correct mirror; q4 produced mirrored parentheses — that's the bug we should prioritize.
sana_ml: ok plan proposal: 1) repro minimal script to isolate detok vs model output, 2) run token-level alignment on failing zh/ar samples, 3) bisect between q8 and q4 kernels (kernel + runtime combo) to see if kernel update caused it, 4) try q4 with different rounding/clamp hyperparams.
li_zhang: I can write the repro. quick command:
```
python tools/repro_multilang.py --model odyssey-lite:v1 --quant q4 --samples data/dev_multilang.jsonl --show-tokens
```
li_zhang: repro script prints token ids/tokens/detok per line so we can see where merge happens.
dave_infra: I'm going to pin a job that runs q4 with runtime v0.9.5 (the q8 kernels) to test kernel influence. kicking off now.
ci-bot: Job 83421 started: odyssey-lite q4 runtime=0.9.5 kernelset=stable. Logs: https://ci.internal/83421
eva_qc: while infra runs, I'll aggregate a 1k-sample diff set and compute chrF with and without punctuation normalization. That will help estimate perf impact on downstream users.
sana_ml: thanks. if we confirm kernel/regression, rollback kernel is acceptable for Dedicated/Private until we fix. For hosted, we'll canary route. also add a prompt-level eval to catch bracket orientation specifically.
toni_localization: can we add bidi-aware detok tests to the eval harness? current suite only checks token overlap. I'd add a small set of rtl bracket cases.
li_zhang: will add unit tests under evals/locale/bidi_parens.json and a wrapper check.
dave_infra: job finished: quick summary — q4 on runtime v0.9.5 reduces BLEU gap: zh->en delta shrunk to 0.2, ar->en to 0.25. So kernel set is the main change.
sana_ml: that strongly implicates kernel selection. let's block the runtime kernel update rollout and open a patch to align q4 kernels with the stable q8 mapping.
eva_qc: I'm filing a regression ticket with sample list + chrF diffs: https://redwood/issues/ML-3281
sana_ml: great. next actions: (li) add repro + unit test, (dave) pin rollback & investigate kernel diff, (eva) attach eval artifacts and severity estimates, (toni) add bidi cases. I'll coordinate and post a follow-up after patch. :thumbsup:
li_zhang: on it, ETA EOD.
dave_infra: starting kernel diff now, will report blockers.
eva_qc: I also recommend we add an entry to the model onboarding checklist to include a small bidi/parens smoke for future multilingual models.
sana_ml: agreed. thanks y'all — keeping this thread open until patch merged.
ci-bot: Issue ML-3281 created by eva_qc. Link: https://redwood/issues/ML-3281
